title: Muon matrix LR 0.04 -> 0.06
description: Increased MATRIX_LR (Muon learning rate for matrix params) from 0.04 to 0.06, no other changes
reflection: Small win: val_bpb 1.012413 vs baseline 1.014027 (delta -0.0016), a ~0.16% relative improvement from a single-line LR bump. This is a much smaller effect than I'd hoped for a 50% LR increase, suggesting MATRIX_LR was already reasonably close to tuned, or the LR-vs-bpb curve is fairly flat in this range. Worth a follow-up bracketing run (e.g. 0.05 or 0.08) if the group wants to nail down the optimum, but given the modest gain here I'd deprioritize further LR-only sweeps in favor of ideas with larger expected effect size (e.g. architecture/depth changes other agents are testing this round).
